meta.title: There is a massive secret ocean locked deep inside the Earth #shorts
meta.description:
You probably think you know all of Earth’s oceans, but there is a massive secret hidden deep beneath your feet. Scientists discovered a colossal reservoir of water locked 700 kilometers down in the Earth's mantle. We are not talking about a trickling underground stream; this hidden ocean holds three times more water than all surface oceans combined. It is trapped inside a vibrant blue rock called ringwoodite, which acts like a giant sponge under immense pressure. This means our planet’s water cycle starts way deeper than we ever imagined, slowly seeping up over billions of years. Without this hidden reservoir, the Earth would likely be dry, and we wouldn't even exist. Would you travel to the center of the Earth if you could? Hit follow for more mind-blowing science!
